Thread.title: Thread
Thread.description: Represents an executive advisory conversation thread owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this thread.

title.description: Display title of the consultation thread.

focusArea.description: Active strategic lens for the consultation thread.

customEtId.description: ID of the active Custom ET agent or 'none' if using Core Eric AI.

pinned.description: Whether the consultation is pinned to the top of the sidebar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents an individual message within a consultation thread.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this message.

threadId.description: The document ID of the parent Thread.

content.description: Markdown text content of the message.

focusArea.description: Strategic lens active when the message was created.

sourcesText.description: Formatted citation links from Google Search grounding.

msgTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds for chronological message ordering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last updated.

CustomET.title: CustomET
CustomET.description: Represents a user-created Custom ET (specialized advisor gem with custom instructions and knowledge base).

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this Custom ET.

name.description: Name of the Custom ET advisor.

tagline.description: Short description or domain scope of the Custom ET.

instructions.description: Custom system prompt directives for the Custom ET.

focusArea.description: Default strategic lens associated with the Custom ET.

knowledgeText.description: Combined text content extracted from uploaded knowledge documents.

knowledgeFileNames.description: Pipe-delimited summary of uploaded knowledge document names and sizes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Custom ET was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Custom ET was last updated.

MemoryItem.title: MemoryItem
MemoryItem.description: Represents a persistent cross-session fact stored in Eric's Memory Bank.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this memory item.

category.description: Domain category of the remembered fact.

content.description: The concise fact remembered across sessions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was last updated.

/threads/{threadId}.description: Stores executive consultation thread metadata owned by individual users.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores individual chat messages linked to a parent thread.

/customEts/{etId}.description: Stores custom ET personas, instructions, and knowledge base text owned by individual users.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Stores persistent cross-session memory facts owned by individual users.
